title: Less than the Label Claimed
story: Before counting spores, Omar checked his hand lens against a slide whose marks he already knew. The lens magnified slightly less than the label claimed, so his first tally would have been low. He adjusted the count by the difference and stuck a note on the case. A newer lens arrived weeks later, already calibrated, and he still tested it. Corrected trust did not become automatic.
